scope.population: 2,480,267 fills of the book-mid panel aggregated to wallet-coin units; 5,539 units are eligible, needing at least 10 fills in EACH half with a finite mean in both
scope.window: 10 days present in the input, day-of-month 4-13, split early [4, 5, 6, 7, 8] against late [9, 10, 11, 12, 13]

declared_not_confirmed.note: settings.py declares these; this run did not state what it used, so they are the declaration and not a property of this artifact

settings_fingerprint.early_late_split: settings.split_early_late over the days present: early [4, 5, 6, 7, 8], late [9, 10, 11, 12, 13]
settings_fingerprint.overrides_note: rank_floor_fills 10, the loosest rung of settings.RANK_FLOOR_SENSITIVITY and NOT the declared 50: at ten fills a per-wallet mean is mostly noise, which is why this file shrinks thin wallets to the population mean rather than ranking them raw; master_seed is settings.MASTER_SEED and is stated as a CONFIRMATION rather than a deviation, the placebo stream being derived from it and the name of the draw through settings.rng, where this file used to declare 20260619; n_perm is settings.N_PERM and is likewise stated as a CONFIRMATION rather than a deviation, so the floor is 1/(N_PERM+1) and not the 0.00498 the earlier 200-draw artifact reported; no bootstrap is drawn, so n_boot does not apply; there is one test here, not a family, so no FDR level applies, and no whale-drop arm runs. The halves are cut by settings.split_early_late over the days present, which on this input returns the same 4-8 / 9-13 the file used to type

liquidation_anchor: DEFERRED - flag dropped at npz-persist and ~0% on BTC/ETH; needs targeted re-pull
interpretation: Toxic/not is now a principled rule, not a flat decile: a Buhlmann-shrunk 10s score (thin wallets pulled to the mean), a per-wallet significance filter, and a cutoff set by out-of-sample validity (AUC predicting the costliest late decile) and by economic break-even (markout above half-spread+rebate = unprofitable to serve). The captured-cost curve is smooth, so the conclusion does not hinge on an exact percentile.
